summary: Step 14: dashboard candidate-review section. New scripts/automation/dashboard_candidate_review.py renders the generated '## 2b. Next-Experiment Candidate Review — Human Decision Required' section into RESEARCH_DASHBOARD.md (BEGIN/END AUTO:NEXT-EXPERIMENT-REVIEW markers) by DISPLAYING the already-accepted automation/reviews/next_experiment_review.yaml verbatim -- review_id, source_fingerprint, candidate_count, GO/REVIEW/NO-GO counts (0/6/2), the accepted rank order for all 8 candidates, each candidate's derived_verdict/verdict_reasons/blockers/required_human_actions/material_difference_requirement status, and the highest-ranked candidate (candidate_afac_low_far_calibration_v1, REVIEW). The renderer contains NO verdict-derivation logic whatsoever -- it never recalculates, reinterprets, reranks, or overrides any field the Brainstorm Checker (NEXT-EXP-REVIEW) already computed; this is statically proven by test_renderer_never_recomputes_a_verdict (source-text scan confirming absence of dataset_readiness==/allowed_split==/evidence_strength==/test_read_risk==/derive_verdict/derive_material_difference). A prominent warning states no verdict authorizes running an experiment, entering the experiment queue, using a frozen protocol, or accessing held-out test data, and that GO means 'suitable for human planning review only.' Candidates 1-6 (all REVIEW) require human planning review; candidates 7-8 (NO-GO) are blocked (dataset_blocked / no_experiment_allowed); AFAC (candidate_afac_low_far_calibration_v1) is explicitly not approved to run. Honest degradation: if automation/reviews/next_experiment_review.yaml is missing, malformed, or structurally inconsistent (duplicate/missing candidate_id, non-contiguous ranks, or summary counts disagreeing with its own entries), the section renders a visible INTEGRITY WARNING instead of silently omitting the section or fabricating data -- covered by synthetic fixtures for all four inconsistency classes. scripts/automation/update_dashboard.py changed minimally: imports dashboard_candidate_review, adds a _candidate_review_sources() helper + r_candidate_review() wrapper, and inserts it into render()'s parts list immediately after r_research_evidence() (as '## 2b.', following the existing '4/4b' numbering convention) -- no other function changed. Tests scripts/automation/test_dashboard_candidate_review.py: 17/17 ALL PASS covering section rendering, exact accepted rank order preservation, exact GO=0/REVIEW=6/NO-GO=2 counts, all 8 candidates appearing exactly once, verdicts matching the accepted review verbatim, NO-GO blockers displayed, D13/D14 material-difference stated_unverified statuses displayed, required human actions displayed, the no-execution-authorization warning present, missing-review integrity warning, four classes of invalid-review integrity warning (malformed YAML, duplicate candidate_id, non-contiguous ranks, summary/entry count disagreement), deterministic+idempotent rendering (both the section alone and the full dashboard twice), existing dashboard sections (##1, ##2 D3 research-evidence, ##3 roadmap) retaining their exact prior content, and confirmation that rendering never mutates automation/registry/experiment_candidates.yaml or automation/experiment_queue.yaml (byte-for-byte before/after). Real-data smoke: r_candidate_review() run against the real committed review shows exactly the 8 candidates in accepted rank order with GO=0/REVIEW=6/NO-GO=2 and the no-execution warning present. Full regression (all unaffected): test_dashboard_research_summary.py 18/18, test_result_explorer.py 40/40, test_next_experiment_brainstorm_checker.py 39/39 + validate_next_experiment_review.py PASS, test_experiment_candidates.py 33/33 + validate_experiment_candidates.py PASS, test_paper_registry.py 28/28 + validate_paper_registry.py PASS, test_experiment_identity.py 32/32 + validate_experiment_identity.py PASS, test_approve.py ALL PASS, test_verify.py ALL PASS. Receipt-impact analysis (read-only, before this claim): grepped every existing receipt for scripts/automation/update_dashboard.py; the only files_created reference (DASH-S3) carries no sha256 (existence-only, unaffected by content edits); all other receipts reference it only in files_modified, never hash-checked by verify_receipt(). Empirically re-ran --verify after the edits: every previously-ACCEPTED task (NEXT-EXP-REVIEW, REG-CANDIDATES, REG-PAPERS, DASH-D3, TOOL-REXP, REG-EXPERIMENT-ID, AUT-APPROVAL-BIND, REG-GOALS, REF-EVID, REG-DATASETS, AUT-TSG-impl, etc.) remained at its exact prior display/checks -- zero drift, no superseding claim required for any existing task. Task DASH-NEXT-EXP-REVIEW registered in automation/tasks.yaml (gated: true, depends_on [NEXT-EXP-REVIEW, DASH-D3], acceptance: null -- no dedicated acceptance spec was authored for this step). automation/reviews/next_experiment_review.yaml, automation/registry/experiment_candidates.yaml, automation/literature/paper_registry.yaml, automation/frontier.yaml, automation/registry/goals.yaml, automation/registry/datasets.yaml, automation/registry/reference_evidence.yaml, automation/registry/experiment_identity.yaml, automation/artifact_manifest.csv, automation/experiment_queue.yaml, all acceptance contracts, protocol-freeze files, test-split-guard files, and Result Explorer code were NOT modified. No experiment, training, validation, model evaluation, export, threshold selection, or test read occurred; no command contained --split; no web access or download occurred.
